method: Per block, its first palette state set without a block update: `water` and `lava` say what a source woken beside it (the cell walled in with stone) did to it within 12 (water) or 40 (lava) ticks: `{"breaks": [items it dropped]}` (the liquid took its place), `"fills"` (water entered its liquid layer: a layer-1 UpdateBlock), `"blocks"` (nothing reached it), `{"becomes": block}` (it turned into another block) or `"crashed"` (setting it crashed the harness). `holds` says whether it kept a still water source it was set into with a block update: `{"sides": [-x, +x, -z, +z]}` (the sides that water spread through once woken), `"popped"` (the block broke on its own and left the source), `"no"` or `"crashed"`.
